reason: Terminated by signal; external cause not reported by the execution service.
unpersisted_attempt_count: Unknown, between zero and ten for the in-flight task. Attempt callbacks were buffered until the trial record was saved.
resume_policy: Keep all persisted rows unchanged. Resume the complete original task list under the original byte-exact source profile, model hashes, parameters, and CPU affinity. The unpersisted task uses fresh OS packet/guard randomness.
measurement_scope: Reported attempt totals and attempt timings cover persisted completed trial records; any unpersisted interrupted work is excluded and not silently counted as zero.
original_bounded_attempt_outcome: Unknown for first_unpersisted_case_id: resume starts a fresh attempt budget.
primary_analysis: Exclude the affected case from primary bounded-attempt, first-attempt, rate, timing and probe estimates; report its resumed record and one-case original-plan bounds separately.
